question: Mapbox publishes an evaluation offer of up to 1 million free Geocoding API requests by application (https://www.mapbox.com/geocoding/evaluation): should it be recorded as its own tier of the Mapbox offer, and what does its request form ask for?
why: The page invites an application, reviewed by Mapbox, with selected applicants followed up; it states no price, term or storage rights, and it is not the card-free demo access. The request form is behind a Request access control and was not read: unverified.
